name: gannet
notes: circle with floats and plunge: Northern gannet: a big white seabird with a buff-yellow head, a dagger of a blue-grey bill and black wingtips, 1.8 m across. Circles twenty-odd metres over deep water on long stiff wings, a few quick beats and a long glide, then folds and drops straight in after fish with a splash, comes up a few seconds later, floats a while and climbs back to do it again. Built on the albatross's shape at 0.4 of its size.
